{"id":1988211248,"question_id":4290,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777171079,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"4 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1988211248/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Elements in an Array","memory":"32.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> findValidElements(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        if(n == 1) return {nums[0]};\n\n        vector<int>leftmax(n) , rightmax(n);\n        leftmax[0] = nums[0];\n        rightmax[n-1] = nums[n-1];\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++) leftmax[i] = max(leftmax[i-1] , nums[i]);\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--) rightmax[i] = max(rightmax[i+1] , nums[i]);\n\n        vector<int>ans;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(i == 0 or i == n-1) ans.push_back(nums[i]);\n            else \n            {\n                if(nums[i] > leftmax[i-1] or nums[i] > rightmax[i+1]) ans.push_back(nums[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-elements-in-an-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1941}
